en: With this meteorite, that thing at Mt. Chimney will be ours to wake! Our boss will be thrilled.
Hey! Who's the kid? Whoever you are, don't expect any mercy from Team Magma!
Hold it right there, Team Magma!
Team Aqua! You lot always turn up where you're not wanted. We've got what we came for. See you around!
Well, well. I've seen you before. Slateport, at the museum, wasn't it?
Team Magma have their meteorite now, and they mean to use it on Mt. Chimney's volcano.
Boss! We should go after Team Magma, right now!
Yes, and quickly. There's no telling what they'll do with it.
As for you, kid... Stay out of grown-up business. Team Aqua will deal with Team Magma. Farewell!
I'm Cozmo, a researcher of meteorites. Those people in red asked so nicely to see my meteorite...
And then they took it! Whatever do they want with it?
What could Team Magma want with a meteorite at Mt. Chimney? It worries me terribly.
